title: Moshi: The Town at the Foot of Kilimanjaro
excerpt: Moshi is the small, relaxed town where most Kilimanjaro climbs begin. What to do there before and after your climb.
body:
Moshi is a lively but relaxed town at the foot of Kilimanjaro. Most climbers spend a night here before and after the mountain, and many wish they had stayed longer.

## The view

On clear mornings and evenings the snowy summit of Kilimanjaro appears above the town. The best chances are early in the morning.

## What to do

- Walk through the central market and the streets around the clock tower.
- Drink locally grown coffee in one of the cafés.
- Visit a [coffee farm and the Materuni waterfall](/blog/materuni-waterfall-coffee-tour/).
- Swim at [Chemka hot springs](/blog/chemka-hot-springs/).
- Do a [day hike on Kilimanjaro](/blog/kilimanjaro-day-hike/).

## Food

Moshi has local restaurants with [nyama choma](/blog/nyama-choma/), Indian restaurants and cafés aimed at travellers. Try [chipsi mayai](/blog/chipsi-mayai/) at a local spot.

## Getting there

Kilimanjaro International Airport is about 45 minutes away by car. Arusha is roughly 1.5 to 2 hours.

## Moshi or Arusha?

Moshi is closer to the main Kilimanjaro gates and has a quieter feel. Arusha is the starting point for safaris. Read our [Arusha guide](/blog/arusha-city-guide/).

## Safety

Moshi is generally relaxed. Use normal precautions: do not walk alone in quiet streets after dark and take a taxi in the evening.
